text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 25 tests. I fixed seven defects under `taskflow/` and left the tests alone.

| File | Defect | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `queue.py` | The sort key was `(seq, -priority)`, so insertion order won over priority. | It's now `(-priority, seq)`. |
| `retry.py` | `should_retry` used `attempts_made < max_attempts - 1`, one retry too few. | It's now `attempts_made < max_attempts`. |
| `statemachine.py` | `batch_order_ok` used `>=`, but priorities in a batch must not increase. | It's now `<=`. |
| `config.py` | The recursive call in `deep_merge` had its arguments swapped, so defaults overrode a task's own settings. | The call is now `deep_merge(result[key], value)`. |
| `scheduler.py` | The skip cascade used direct `dependents` only. | It now uses `transitive_dependents`. |
| `events.py` | `_prefix_matches` had the prefix and topic reversed, so prefix subscribers like `History` never received `job.term.*` events. | It's now `topic.startswith(prefix + ".")`. |
| `resources.py` | `ResourcePool.release` subtracted 1 instead of `cost`, so multi-unit resources were never fully released. | It now subtracts `cost`. |
